blocks.title: Enable Grant a provider access for {organization}
blocks.purpose: Lets a service provider you choose on apps.ever.co (for example an accountant or payroll provider) work in your installation with a role and scope you pick. The grant shows in Integrations & data and you can revoke it at any time.

leaves_installation.purpose: Show whether the grant is active

arrives_at_installation.purpose: Role the provider gets in the installation

blocks.where_to_change: Integrations & data in this product, or Instances in app.ever.co; turning it off stops the data at once.
blocks.revoke_effect: The provider's access is removed from the installation.
blocks.authorisation: I am authorised to enable this for {organization}
